mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO prescription_item(prescription_id, medicine_id, quantity, unit_price) VALUES
(#{item.prescriptionId}, #{item.medicineId}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.unitPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT pi.item_id AS itemId, pi.prescription_id AS prescriptionId, pi.medicine_id AS medicineId, pi.quantity, pi.unit_price AS unitPrice, d.drug_name AS medicineName, d.specification, d.dosage_form AS dosageForm FROM prescription_item pi LEFT JOIN drug d ON pi.medicine_id = d.drug_id WHERE pi.prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} ORDER BY pi.item_id
